description: Reconcile the approved spec .kiro/specs/whatsapp-wix-commerce/requirements.md to the owner's 2026-10-01 website-only ruling: the 'pay inside WhatsApp' and 'WhatsApp-only receipts' statements become website Razorpay Standard Checkout plus a private downloadable receipt, while every other load-bearing invariant is preserved verbatim in effect. Can run in parallel with FEAT-002/003 (independent doc change) but is ordered after them so the spec reflects the retired producer. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Edit the 'Owner architecture decision — 2026-10-01' paragraph (around line 5): replace 'WhatsApp/Razorpay collects payment externally' and 'Retain admin-only Cognito and WhatsApp-only receipts' so the decision reads: payment is collected on the website via Razorpay Standard Checkout (the gated website checkout path), and the customer receives a private, authenticated downloadable receipt. Keep: reuse the existing Next.js/AWS headless app; create the internal order and Wix order only after authoritative verification; record the external payment without charging again; Velo and external PSP onboarding are not dependencies; admin-only Cognito retained for staff.

Edit statement 8: it currently says the Meta payment configuration is absent so payment is disabled. Reframe to the website ruling: in-WhatsApp payment is removed from the active purchase flow; payment is collected on the website via Razorpay Standard Checkout, and the website initiation remains gated/disabled until its full provider-driven readiness contract is met. Preserve the factual 'disabled until ready' posture.

PRESERVE statement 9 verbatim in effect: payment readiness is provider-driven; no local constant and no environment variable may enable payment; an unrecognised configuration fails closed before the send. Do not weaken this.

Edit statement 10: change 'The final confirmation and the receipt are WhatsApp-only. No purchase-confirmation email is sent' to reflect that the receipt is a private, authenticated, bounded-expiry downloadable document on the website (rendered from the immutable paid snapshot), while WhatsApp may still deliver authorized order/receipt NOTIFICATIONS. Keep the no-purchase-confirmation-email point if the owner's direction preserves it (email remains for verification/account security); state receipt delivery is website download, notifications may be WhatsApp.

Edit the Goals section: change 'build a cart, pay inside WhatsApp, and receive exactly one order with exactly one charge' so payment happens on the website; keep 'exactly one order with exactly one charge, a billing document, and a tracking link' and the staff-facing view of every order/payment/reconciliation/shipment.

Edit the Non-goals section as needed so nothing there re-asserts WhatsApp-only payment; PRESERVE the non-goals that remain binding: no second frontend framework, no replacing the invoice engine, no rotating/revoking/reading any provider credential value (MANUAL_OWNER_ACTION), no WhatsApp/WABA/phone-number-ID/business-portfolio mutation, no enabling any live-send flag.

PRESERVE verbatim in effect the other load-bearing invariants: statement 1 (public Cognito self-signup disabled), 2 (trusted backend front door, never browser SignUp), 3 (per-IP throttling at the HTTP door), 4 (PaymentAttempt before payment, order does not exist yet), 5 (reference_id minted once from secrets, sent byte-for-byte), 6 (order identity requires provider readback; webhook is a trigger not proof), 7 (failed/cancelled/expired/pending creates zero orders/numbers/Wix orders/receipts). Do not alter the paid-only order-creation rule or the reference_id rules.

Add a short dated note (2026-10-01) at the top of the overriding-statements block recording that this reconciliation implements the owner's website-only ruling and supersedes the prior WhatsApp-only payment/receipt wording, so the history is auditable. If design.md or tasks.md in the same spec folder restate WhatsApp-only payment/receipt as the architecture, add a one-line pointer note there to the website-only ruling (do not rewrite those files wholesale).
Record in findings a concise diff summary of exactly which statements/paragraphs changed and which were preserved.
acceptance_criteria: requirements.md Owner-decision paragraph, statement 8, statement 10, Goals, and Non-goals reflect website Razorpay Standard Checkout + private downloadable receipt; in-WhatsApp payment is no longer stated as the active architecture
Statement 9 (provider-driven readiness; no constant/env var may enable payment) is preserved unchanged in effect
Statements 1-7, the paid-only order-creation rule, and the reference_id rules are preserved; the admin-only Cognito / no-live-send / no-provider-mutation non-goals are preserved
A dated note records the reconciliation and supersession for auditability
findings contains the statement-level diff summary
findings: Statement-level diff of .kiro/specs/whatsapp-wix-commerce/requirements.md (plus one-line pointer notes in design.md and tasks.md). CHANGED: (1) Owner architecture decision paragraph (~line 5): 'WhatsApp/Razorpay collects payment externally' -> 'Payment is collected on the website via Razorpay Standard Checkout (the gated website checkout path)'; 'Retain admin-only Cognito and WhatsApp-only receipts' -> 'customer receives a private, authenticated downloadable receipt on the website' + 'Retain admin-only Cognito for staff'. Preserved: reuse existing Next.js/AWS headless app, create internal+Wix order only after authoritative verification, record external payment without charging again, Velo/external PSP not dependencies. (2) Statement 8: 'Meta payment configuration is currently absent...payment is disabled until the owner restores it' -> 'In-WhatsApp payment is removed from the active purchase flow; payment is collected on the website via Razorpay Standard Checkout; website checkout initiation remains gated and disabled until its full provider-driven readiness contract is met' (disabled-until-ready posture preserved). (3) Statement 10: 'The final confirmation and the receipt are WhatsApp-only' -> 'The receipt is a private, authenticated, bounded-expiry downloadable document on the website, rendered from the immutable paid snapshot; WhatsApp may still deliver authorized order and receipt notifications'; email-for-verification/account-security point kept verbatim. (4) Goals (~line 76): 'pay inside WhatsApp' -> 'pay on the website via Razorpay Standard Checkout'; kept 'exactly one order with exactly one charge, a billing document, and a tracking link' and the staff-facing view; replaced an em dash with a comma (no em dashes added). (5) Added a dated 'Reconciliation note, 2026-10-01' block at the top of the ten-statements section recording the website-only ruling and supersession of the prior WhatsApp-only payment/receipt wording. (6) design.md and tasks.md: added a single '> Superseded 2026-10-01 (website-only ruling)' pointer line after their owner-decision paragraph (paragraphs otherwise untouched; files not rewritten). PRESERVED verbatim in effect: statement 9 (provider-driven readiness; no local constant or env var may enable payment; unrecognised config fails closed), statements 1-7 (Cognito self-signup disabled, trusted backend front door never browser SignUp, per-IP throttling at the HTTP door, PaymentAttempt before order, reference_id minted once from secrets and sent byte-for-byte, order identity requires provider readback, failed/cancelled/expired/pending creates zero orders/numbers/Wix orders/receipts), the paid-only order-creation rule, the reference_id rules, and the Non-goals (no second frontend framework, no replacing the invoice engine, no rotating/revoking/reading provider credentials = MANUAL_OWNER_ACTION, no WhatsApp/WABA/phone-number-ID/business-portfolio mutation, no enabling any live-send flag, native app packaging post-project). Non-goals needed no edit as none re-asserted WhatsApp-only payment. VERIFY: no test pins the old spec wording (grep over tests/ clean); .venv pytest -q => 5734 passed, 1 skipped (matches baseline). Docs-only change, no code touched.
